claims.text: It comes as two products:

**Kaiord SDK**: the published libraries and tools that read, validate and convert training data. That is `@kaiord/core`, the format adapters (`@kaiord/fit`, `@kaiord/tcx`, `@kaiord/zwo`, `@kaiord/garmin`), the command-line tool `@kaiord/cli`, and the MCP server `@kaiord/mcp`.
**[Kaiord App](https://kaiord.com/app/)**: the browser application an athlete uses to see, plan and move their data, together with the browser extensions it relies on.
**[Kaiord App](https://kaiord.com/app/)**: create and edit workouts in your browser, with no account.

claims.text: Kaiord keeps no accounts and stores no user data on its own infrastructure. It runs two Cloudflare Workers: one in front of the site, which adds headers for AI agents, and one at `kaiord.com/mcp` and `kaiord.com/a2a`, which converts workouts in transit. Neither binds any storage. Your data leaves your device only to destinations you configured:

claims.text: **Storage is your browser's IndexedDB.** The [Kaiord App](https://kaiord.com/app/) persists every workout, template, profile, and setting in a local Dexie.js / IndexedDB database (`KaiordDatabase` in [`dexie-database.ts`](./packages/workout-spa-editor/src/adapters/dexie/dexie-database.ts)).

**Conversions run on your machine.** In the Kaiord App and in [`@kaiord/cli`](./packages/cli), FIT / TCX / ZWO / GCN ↔ KRD conversion happens in-process ([`import-workout-formats.ts`](./packages/workout-spa-editor/src/utils/import-workout-formats.ts), [`export-workout-formats.ts`](./packages/workout-spa-editor/src/utils/export-workout-formats.ts)).

claims.text: **The assistant calls the AI provider whose key you enter.** Anthropic, OpenAI or Google is called directly from your browser, with what the conversation needs, including summaries of your workouts and health data. The App's content security policy lists those three hosts and no other model service.

claims.text: **Each extension reaches one platform, with your own session.** Garmin Connect, Train2Go, Tanita, TrainingPeaks and WHOOP each have their own browser extension, which may only reach that platform's hosts. The Garmin extension keeps its Garmin tokens in your browser; they never travel to Kaiord.
